class.name: humanoid_transport_stm32/Stm32SerialTransport
class.description: Production transport (ADR-001-04): the master-link protocol of soccer-firmware over USB CDC to the master STM32, which schedules the 200 Hz SPI and CAN exchange to the RobStride drives. Selected by setting transport_plugin to "humanoid_transport_stm32/Stm32SerialTransport" in the hardware YAML. Configured by the "stm32_serial" node's parameters.
